Körfezin bu dönemdeki en önemli yerleşim: The most important settlement in the gulf in this period: a village enclosed by 3.5 m high walls reinforced with horseshoe-shaped towers.
Bugünkü ilçe sınırındaki en erken yerleş: The earliest settlement evidence within today's district boundary. İnkaya is identified as a cult site, not a village.
Halk ana yerleşim alanına döndü; sanayi: The population returned to the core settlement; industry and trade revived.
İyon isyanına Pers ordusunun karşılığı ü: After the Persian army's response to the Ionian revolt, the population took refuge on the island; no remains were found on the mainland for at least a century.
Adadaki yerleşim MS 5. yüzyıl başına dek: The island settlement continued until the early 5th century AD. Wall traces of Roman farmhouses were found on the mainland; the latest pottery dates to the 6th–7th centuries AD.
Türkler Çaka Bey ile Ege'ye ulaştı ve Kl: The Turks reached the Aegean with Çaka Bey and captured coastal cities such as Klazomenai. About two centuries of Turkish–Byzantine struggle followed.
II. Mehmed dönemi tahrir defterinde Seki: In the land survey register of Mehmed II's reign, the villages of Seki and Yelki are attached to Kilizman. Estimated population: Kilizman 408, Seki/Yelki 389.
Kanuni dönemi defterinde bölge padişahın: In the register of Suleiman the Magnificent's reign, the area is part of the Sultan's personal domain. Çamlı appears for the first time: 888 people.
Kilizman 348 kişiye indi (−%14,7), Seki/: Kilizman fell to 348 people (−14.7%), Seki/Yelki rose to 545 (+40.1%).
Kilizman'da 4 çadır ve 16 erkek, Çamlı'd: 4 tents and 16 men in Kilizman, 20 tents and 43 men in Çamlı. These are community subsets, not village totals.
Bugünkü ilçedeki Kilizman, Yelki, Payaml: Kilizman, Yelki, Payamlı and Çamlı in today's district: 1,630 people and 383 buildings (Aydın Province Yearbook).
Yunanistan'dan (Girit, Selanik, Manastır: Exchangees from Greece (Crete, Thessaloniki, Monastir, etc.) were settled in place of the departing non-Muslim population.
Yerleşim Urla'ya bağlı bucak oldu ve Kız: The settlement became a sub-district of Urla and took the name Kızılbahçe. The reports date this change differently, as 1928–1929 and 1936.
Resmî MEB kaydına göre okul 1933'te açıl: According to the official Ministry of Education record, the school opened in 1933; today it is one of the district's recognisable civic landmarks.
Karadeniz'den gelen göçmenler balıkçılık: Migrants from the Black Sea region settled through fishing; summer houses and entertainment venues were built on the coast. After an epidemic locals called the "plague", the settlement's focus shifted to the coast.
Yerleşim belediye örgütlenmesine kavuştu: The settlement gained a municipal organisation.
Soğuk Savaş ikliminde \"Kızıl\" sözcüğün: Amid Cold War discomfort with the word "Kızıl" (Red), the name became Güzelbahçe and the municipality was attached to İzmir's Central District. The reports give 1957 and 1958.
Bucak ve köylerinin toplam nüfusu 4.978': The total population of the sub-district and its villages rose from 4,978 to 5,515 (about 10.8%).
S.S. Güzelbahçe Su Ürünleri Kooperatifi: The S.S. Güzelbahçe Fisheries Cooperative was founded; it serves fishers in harvesting, storage and marketing.
1980 askerî darbesinin ardından belediye: After the 1980 military coup the municipality was abolished; Güzelbahçe was attached to İzmir Municipality.
Otoyol gelişmeyi hızlandırdı ve yazlıkla: The motorway accelerated development and summer homes became permanent residences. From the 1990s, thousands of homes were built through cooperatives.
Güzelbahçe ve Narlıdere \"Narlıbahçe\" a: Güzelbahçe and Narlıdere were merged as "Narlıbahçe"; residents opposed it with hunger strikes and tent protests.
Güzelbahçe ayrı ilçe oldu; kaymakamlık 1: Güzelbahçe became a separate district; the district governorship began operating in 1994.
Yelki, Atatürk ve Cumhuriyet mahalleleri: Yelki became a town municipality with the Atatürk and Cumhuriyet quarters; under Law No. 5747 it became a neighbourhood of Güzelbahçe in 2008.
Binlerce katılımcıyla düzenlenen oyunlar: The games, with thousands of participants, helped promote the district. Trial ferry services in 2003 could not be continued because of bureaucratic obstacles.
Kapalı site tipi konut projeleriyle birl: With gated housing projects, the district became an education hub with a concentration of private schools.
